description: This file contains unit tests for the NotificationForwardingPolicy class and related functionality such as parsing time strings and checking quiet hours behaviors.

classes.name: NotificationForwardingPolicyTest
classes.description: Test suite for NotificationForwardingPolicy class and associated functions, verifying behavior like package filtering, quiet hours handling, and rate limiting.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_parsesValidValues
methods.description: Tests that valid time strings are correctly parsed into minute offsets.

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_acceptsStrict24HourDrafts
methods.description: Tests that valid 24-hour time strings are normalized correctly.

methods.name: parseLocalHourMinute_rejectsInvalidValues
methods.description: Verifies that various invalid time strings are rejected (return null).

methods.name: normalizeLocalHourMinute_rejectsNonCanonicalDrafts
methods.description: Verifies that non-canonical time strings are rejected by normalization.

methods.name: allowsPackage_blocklistBlocksConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Checks that the blocklist mode correctly blocks configured packages.

methods.name: allowsPackage_allowlistOnlyAllowsConfiguredPackages
methods.description: Checks that the allowlist mode correctly allows configured packages and blocks others.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_handlesWindowCrossingMidnight
methods.description: Validates quiet hours detection when the window crosses midnight.

methods.name: isWithinQuietHours_sameStartEndMeansAlwaysQuiet
methods.description: Verifies behavior when quiet start and end times are the same (full-day quiet).

methods.name: blocksEventsWhenDisabledOrQuietHoursOrRateLimited
methods.description: Tests that notifications are blocked when the policy is disabled, during quiet hours, or rate-limited.

methods.name: burstLimiter_blocksEventsAboveLimitInSameMinute
methods.description: Ensures that burst limiting blocks notifications exceeding the allowed per-minute count.

methods.name: burstLimiter_resetsOnNextMinuteWindow
methods.description: Verifies burst limit resets on the change of minute window.
